summary: I watch as poems slip by unseen truths in stanzas caught in our eye metaphors untie as we try to blink dry tears away from a sty in the stars that supply such vision #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I watch as poems
slip by
unseen truths
in stanzas
caught in our
eye
metaphors untie
as we try to blink
dry tears
away from a sty
in the stars
that supply
such vision
#smallpoems
